title: Delectable Meat Growth
author: Kreature's BoneBox
desc: Unleash your strength with Kreature's BoneBox: Delectable Meat Growth, a focused 1-week program designed for those ready to elevate their training. Comprising two intense sessions per week, this program targets key muscle groups with a mix of barbell and dumbbell exercises, including Hip Thrusts and Romanian Deadlifts, ensuring your glutes and legs are primed for growth. Each workout is structured around progressive rep ranges to maximize your gains, making it perfect for lifters looking to push their limits. Get ready to transform your physique and build a solid foundation!

ex.note: Can also be done with dumbbell!
You should not be feeling this in your back! If so, try a single leg variation or stop immediately. A reminder that it's OK to not perform the entire workout👍
Do not do traditional hamstring curls; instead, perform this action by lying face down on a bench or similar surface and trap a dumbbell between your feet, then, bend your legs to raise it.
